figures.name: holders_window_mismatches
figures.basis: predicted: every unrouted record's segmentsFetched equals its statement's unrouted_fetched_expected, the resolved set plus token_only_fetched: the resolved set is named_in_window (the objects in the window holding a series of the statement's one metric, since the unrouted resolve prunes by that name's postings) when every selector names one metric and segments_in_window (every object in the window) when they name different metrics; token_only_fetched is the listed L0 objects outside that set named by a min_commit_token the query lane passed (one per shard), which the resolve adds whatever their metrics and event time. (ci evidence for this check is in stage1-bands.ci.json)

figures.name: holders_routed_prune_mismatches

(ci evidence for this check is in stage1-bands.ci.json)

figures.name: holders_routed_prune_unchecked

figures.name: holders_routed_leaf_unread

(ci evidence for this check is in stage1-bands.ci.json)

R6 opened 2,899, release metricsbench-r6-20261105

figures.name: erasure_erased_hours
figures.basis: predicted: metricsbench-instance-0 series are written on every cardinality run, so the rewrite replaces the data objects of at least one ingest hour (erasure_keys_surviving asks for every listed key to be replaced; this band keeps a listing with no key before from passing that); an erased hour is an ingest_hour_bucket holding a catalog list --json key before the erasure that is not listed after its fold, since a rewrite output is a new content-keyed L1 key in the same hour (crates/ravel-maintain/src/erasure_rewrite.rs build_rewrite_part, keys::l1_part_key) that supersedes its inputs. A compaction the maintain container ran in the same window also reads as an erased hour

figures.name: erasure_keys_surviving
figures.basis: predicted: metricsbench-instance-0 is written in every ingest hour on every shard, and a COMPLETED windowless erasure rewrites every listed (shard, hour) bucket (services/ravel-server/src/maintain.rs:3614-3626, overlap by event time only, crates/ravel-maintain/src/erasure_rewrite.rs:2385-2391), copying the series it does not erase into the new part (erasure_rewrite.rs:1180-1192) under a new key (crates/ravel-commit/src/erasure.rs:429-445), and a fully erased bucket writes no part (erasure_rewrite.rs:1377-1378), so no data-object key catalog list --json lists before the submit is listed after the fold; keys_surviving names up to 20 that are. erasure_erased_hours at least 1 keeps an empty listing from passing this

figures.name: erasure_carried_over_erased_hours

figures.name: erasure_stale_leaves
